methods.name: getsf · official extraction
methods.note: Actual getsf260706 ran on the full1024×1024 crop but did not complete before the agreed experiment deadline. Source background completed 11 iterations; last relative correction 0.0094, convergence target0.005. No final component maps or catalog were produced.

metadata.crop: Native 1024×1024 pixels; original origin (1900, 700). No resampling.
limitations: All quantities use display sRGB, not calibrated photometry or measured gas density.
Compact/filament labels describe morphology; they do not distinguish foreground stars from intrinsic knots.
Residuals must remain accounted for. Exact reconstruction alone cannot validate a decomposition.
This experiment compares automatic 2D extraction. No new 3D depth model has been baked.
